stages.title: Audience and outcomes
stages.description: Who the course is for and what they can do after it.
tasks: Describe the ideal learner and their starting level
Check what similar courses already cover
Decide format, length and price range

stages.title: Syllabus and lesson plan
stages.description: The module and lesson structure that leads to the outcomes.
tasks: List lessons with a goal for each
Order lessons from simple to hard

stages.title: Create lessons
stages.description: Record or write the actual teaching content.
tasks: Write scripts or slides for module 1

stages.title: Exercises and assessments
stages.description: Practice that proves the outcomes were reached.
tasks: Write a grading or self-check guide

stages.title: Platform and course page
stages.description: Where learners find, buy and take the course.
tasks: Set up the course structure and payments
Write the course page and syllabus summary

stages.title: Pilot with first learners
stages.description: Run the course with a small group before opening it to everyone.

stages.title: Improve from feedback
tasks: Update the course page with results

stages.title: Open enrollment
stages.description: The course is available to everyone.
